summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer, strong advocate for open source software, passionate about privacy and anti-DRM, critical of corporate monopolies (especially Apple and Microsoft), active in discussions about software patents, interested in decentralized social networks (Diaspora), supports Linux and open standards, engaged in mobile Linux projects (Mer, Nemo Mobile), critical of vendor lock-in practices, promotes interoperability in technology, has a technical background in programming (C++), interested in digital rights and internet freedom.
